provenance: Captured against FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 on macOS, 2026-10-24. `pasted` is the step as pasted, `fm` FileMaker's copy of it, `fmLine` the line FileMaker draws for it, `hr` the converter's HR for `fm`. `roundTrip` says how HR -> XML of `hr` compares with `fm`: exact; exceptFlags (the four hidden option flags come back at FileMaker's insert defaults); exceptCurl (FileMaker's default <CURLOptions> is added); exceptFlagsAndCurl; hrOnly (FileMaker's copy-out of a step pasted without its option flags holds no <Flow>, which HR -> XML writes). Field ids are not compared (converted without a solution context). `fmLineConverts`: FileMaker's own line converts to `fm` exactly (the line holds every stored value). The element names (Auth, JSONData, the step-level Calculation as the URL, Field as the target) were read from a step configured in FileMaker's own dialog.
